_note: Recipe-dispatched by name: icon-sets-openmoji runs the openmoji-sets recipe (src/internal/core/recipes), which fetches one pinned OpenMoji release tag from hfg-gmuend/openmoji and writes the colour and black sets. It shares its pipelines with the deprecated openmoji sets inside icon-sets-emoji, so the two stay byte-identical. OpenMoji tags have no `v` prefix. `licence` is guarded: a sync whose upstream LICENSE.txt no longer opens as CC-BY-SA 4.0 fails before touching the pack.
name: icon-sets-openmoji
